name: KR QUANTEC HC

urls.caption: KUKA, KR QUANTEC HC Medical Robot

description: 6-axis high-payload (up to 300 kg payload, 2,701 mm reach) industrial robot arm optimized for OEM integration into heavy medical equipment, such as radiation therapy systems and heavy C-arm X-ray imaging units. Features specialized medical safety enhancements including auxiliary brakes on axes 2 through 5, manual brake release mechanisms for power loss situations, integrated digital pressure sensors for abnormal load detection, and submillimeter positioning repeatability (±0.05 mm). Encapsulated structure rated IP65 with customizable protective covers for clinical environments.
